(section) Sec. 5 (7-15-320(B))
(quote) STRUCK: persons sixty-five years of age or older;
(other) Sec. 1: short title, Secure, Accurate, and Verifiable Elections Act.
(other) Sec. 2 (new 7-5-200): only paper poll books; electronic poll books banned.
(other) Sec. 3 (new 7-13-870): hand-marked paper ballots on watermarked paper, counted by hand at each precinct in public view and by streamed video; keeps one accessible voting system per polling place.
(other) Sec. 4 (new 7-13-880): chain-of-custody records for all election equipment and materials, kept 24 months.
(other) Sec. 5 (7-15-320): removes early-voting references and strikes absentee eligibility for people 65 or older.
(other) Sec. 6 (53-5-10): makes general election day a legal holiday.
(other) Sec. 7: effective on approval by the Governor.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2024-01-24). No ID or citizenship text in slots a-d. Slot e entry is a removal of an absentee-eligibility category, not ID.
(other) note: Strike/new markers restored from HTML styling. Not an ID or citizenship bill; included only because of the absentee-eligibility change. Only the introduced text is saved.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
